title: Riot Stock Up 13% After $28B AI Lease: Why?
description: Riot Platforms signed a 15-year, roughly $28 billion lease with an unnamed AI lab for its Corsicana, Texas campus. The stock was up about 12.8% by 10 a.m. Eastern Wednesday.

sources.title: Riot Platforms reports Q3 2026 results and Corsicana lease (company release via StockTitan, Nov 4 2026)
Riot Platforms Soars on Earnings and $28 Billion Corsicana AI Lease (24/7 Wall St, Nov 4 2026)
Stocks Jump in the Stock Market Today Live, November 4, 2026 (StockTitan)

beats.say: Riot Platforms signed a twenty eight billion dollar deal with an AI lab. Here's the stock reaction so far.
Riot signed a lease for its entire Corsicana, Texas campus. The tenant is an unnamed frontier AI lab. About twenty eight billion dollars over fifteen years.

visual.headline: Riot signs lease for entire Corsicana campus with a leading frontier AI lab

beats.say: In August, this was only a nonbinding letter of intent. Now it's signed. Rival MARA says it expects to sign at least one AI lease before year end.

items.text: MARA expects a lease by year end

beats.say: Thirteen percent at ten a.m. Eastern. It's still early.
A signed lease is firmer than a plan. And that's why
